en.name: GitHub
en.description: Work on GitHub issues and PRs

playbooks.title: My open issues
playbooks.prompt: List my open Linear issues by priority and tell me which are blocked.

playbooks.title: File a bug
playbooks.prompt: File a Linear issue for the bug I describe next, with steps to reproduce.

methods.help: Create an API token from your Atlassian account security settings.
Create a personal access token with read_api scope in GitLab settings.
For Plane Cloud, use the default API base URL. For self-hosted Plane, enter your instance API base URL.
Create an API token in your Forgejo user settings under Applications.
Create a Power-Up at trello.com/power-ups/admin to get an API key, then generate a token from the API key page.
Open Asana and go to My Settings > Apps, click on Developer Apps and create a new Personal Access Token.
Generate a token from Monday.com Admin API settings.

en.name: Notion
en.description: Read Notion pages and databases, and organize notes
abilities: Search and read pages and databases

playbooks.title: Find a page
playbooks.prompt: Find my Notion page about the product roadmap and summarize what is planned next.

playbooks.title: Capture notes
playbooks.prompt: Create a Notion page "Ideas" with three ideas from our conversation.

methods.help: Create an API key in Featurebase dashboard settings.
Create an API key from Plain settings.

en.name: 飞书
abilities: Read and write Feishu docs and wiki pages

playbooks.title: Summarize a doc
playbooks.prompt: Find my most recently edited Feishu doc and summarize it in five bullet points.

playbooks.title: Meeting notes to doc
playbooks.prompt: Write the notes of today's meeting into a new Feishu doc with decisions and owners.

en.name: 腾讯文档
abilities: Create, read and edit Tencent Docs

playbooks.title: Draft a doc
playbooks.prompt: Create a Tencent Doc titled "Weekly plan" with this week's priorities as a checklist.

playbooks.title: Tidy a sheet
playbooks.prompt: Open my latest Tencent Docs sheet and tell me what columns it has and what looks inconsistent.

en.description: Only accesses the “咕咕” folder in Baidu Netdisk

abilities: Read and write files in /apps/咕咕

playbooks.title: List the app folder
playbooks.prompt: List the files in /apps/咕咕 in Baidu Netdisk.

en.name: 腾讯会议
en.description: Manage meetings, recordings and meeting notes

playbooks.title: Upcoming meetings

en.name: 滴答清单
en.description: Read and write your Dida365 tasks

playbooks.title: Today's tasks
playbooks.prompt: List my Dida tasks due today and suggest an order to do them.

playbooks.title: Capture to-dos
playbooks.prompt: Add these to my Dida inbox: buy printer paper, reply to the landlord, book a dentist appointment.

en.name: 高德地图
en.description: Places, routes, travel time and weather from AMap

methods.help: Free: sign in to the AMap open platform, create an app and add a key with the service type “Web 服务”, then paste it here.

abilities: Search places and what is nearby
Plan driving, transit, walking and cycling routes
Check distance, travel time and weather

playbooks.title: How long to get there
playbooks.prompt: How long does it take from Beijing South Railway Station to the Forbidden City by subway and by car right now?

playbooks.title: Find somewhere nearby
playbooks.prompt: Find three well-rated coffee shops within 1 km of Shanghai Jing'an Temple and tell me how to walk there.

en.name: 钉钉
en.description: DingTalk contacts, chats, calendar, to-dos, approvals and docs

prerequisite.text: Ask your organization admin to allow access, then confirm authorization in DingTalk.

playbooks.title: My day on DingTalk
playbooks.prompt: What is on my DingTalk calendar today, and which to-dos are due?

playbooks.title: Pending approvals
playbooks.prompt: List the approvals waiting for me on DingTalk and summarize each in one line.

en.name: 企业微信
en.description: WeCom messages, docs, calendar, to-dos and meetings

prerequisite.text: Scan with the WeCom app. WeCom creates a smart bot for you, and agents act as that bot.

abilities: Send messages and files to chats

playbooks.title: Schedule a meeting
playbooks.prompt: Book a 30-minute WeCom meeting with me tomorrow afternoon titled "Weekly sync" and send me the link.

playbooks.title: My WeCom to-dos
playbooks.prompt: List my open WeCom to-dos and mark the ones I finished today as done.

en.name: QQ 邮箱

methods.help: In QQ Mail on the web: Settings → Account and security → turn on IMAP/SMTP, then generate an authorization code.

abilities: Search mail by sender, subject, date or words in it
Read a message, with its attachments listed
Send and reply from this address

playbooks.title: Unread digest
playbooks.prompt: Go through my unread mail from the last 3 days and give me a short digest: who wrote, what they want, and what needs a reply.

playbooks.title: Find a message
playbooks.prompt: Find the latest email about an invoice or a receipt and tell me what it says.

playbooks.title: Draft a reply
playbooks.prompt: Read my most recent email that asks me something and draft a polite reply. Show me the draft before sending.
